summary: Verified all 6 fixes of this session (FIX-1..FIX-6) on the static build + ran an extra read-only table audit of KEUANGAN / KAS & ASET / RFID / Approvals / Pusat Dokumen / Sourcing / Master Pembelian / Settings. ALL SIX FIXES PASS. Backend: 3/3 pytest for Blanket-PO unit validation (bogus unit 'karung' -> 400 with clear message, master unit accepted & persisted, call-off unit mismatch -> 400). Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): PO table numbers & status badges no longer wrap (nowrap + overflow-x-auto), cb-list-table is full-width with cb-detail-empty removed and detail panel toggling works both ways, interco item tables are table-fixed with identical Qty(170px)/Lot(220px) x-positions across cards and py-1.5/px-2 padding, Blanket unit is a KNSelect (disabled before product, auto-fills base unit, options from UOM master), PO creation from UI works end-to-end (created KSC/PO-00020, status 'Menunggu Barang'), PO board numbers are blue buttons that open the PO document, and stage chips open PoStageModal and change colour after save (PATCH 200). One NEW HIGH bug found during the extra audit: Pengaturan -> Aturan Persetujuan renders every rule blank/Inactive because the UI reads a completely different schema than the API returns.

critical.issue: Schema mismatch with UI & with the enforcement data. GET returns seeded engine rules {doc_type, entity_id, min_amount, max_amount, required_role, sort, active:true} while ApprovalRulesSettings.jsx and ApprovalRuleUpdate expect {name, entity_type, threshold_field, threshold_operator, threshold_value, approver_role, priority, is_active}. Result: settings table shows blank rule names, 'Entity Type —', 'Condition 0', 'Approver —', empty Priority and 'Inactive' status for all 9 active rules; the toggle/edit writes is_active/threshold_* keys that the approval engine never reads (silent no-op on approval policy).

ui_bugs.issue: All 9 rows render empty (name blank, entity '—', condition '0', approver '—', priority blank, status 'Inactive') although API returns 9 active rules. Field mapping bug (see backend_issues).

issues: UNIT KNSelect column is ~60px wide: the trigger shows 'yar...' and the opened dropdown (~62px) truncates/wraps every option ('yard (satu dasa', 'Mete (m)', 'Centi (cm)'). Functionally correct but hard to read — widen the UNIT column or the popover.
Dropdown popover overlaps the 'Plafon Nilai Kontrak / Plafon Efektif' block instead of being clipped to the item row.
'Berlaku Mulai/Sampai' use the native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy, US order) instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere.

Expected grade is mandatory but has no default and no visible label — only the placeholder 'Grade *' inside a cramped 8-control row; the blocking message ('Pilih Grade yang diharapkan untuk item ini') appears only AFTER pressing 'Tambah Item'. This is the most likely reason users report 'tidak bisa membuat PO'. Suggest inline hint/asterisk label or defaulting to product's standard grade.
'Perkiraan Pengiriman' uses native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy), not the shadcn calendar.
Choosing a group-entity supplier (CV Kanda Suka) correctly disables submit with a guiding banner — good, but the disabled primary button keeps the same prominence, so a user may keep clicking it.
The 5 group tables render with NO thead (th=0) while rows have 4 cells — columns (kode/nama/tipe/saldo) are unlabeled. Cosmetic/legibility only; alignment itself is consistent.

When the detail panel is open the list shrinks to 752px and the 'JADWAL BAYAR' column disappears while supplier names wrap to 2 lines. Acceptable responsive behaviour, no clipping detected (inner div handles scroll), but the min-w-[880px] on the table is only honoured through the inner overflow-auto wrapper — worth keeping in mind.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): align Aturan Persetujuan UI + /api/approval-rules PATCH schema with the actual stored/enforced rule shape (doc_type, entity_id, min_amount/max_amount, required_role, sort, active) — today the screen shows every active rule as blank & Inactive and edits do not affect approval routing.
Cosmetic: widen the UNIT column/popover in blanket-create-modal so UOM option labels are readable.
UX: give 'Expected Grade' in po-create-modal a visible label (or default) and validate inline instead of only after 'Tambah Item'.
Cosmetic: replace native date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) in po-create-modal and blanket-create-modal with the shadcn calendar / dd-mm-yyyy format.

Cleanup test data: blanket contracts KSC/PO-00018 & KSC/PO-00019 (notes TEST_ITER272), purchase order KSC/PO-00020 (notes 'TEST_ITER272 PO dari UI'), and PO KSC/PO-00015 stage 'celup' was set to in_progress with note 'TEST_ITER272 celup mulai'.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/approval_rules.py implements a second, parallel rule model (name/threshold_*/is_active) that no approval engine reads, while services consume doc_type/min_amount/required_role/active. Two schemas for one collection is the root cause of the blank settings table — collapse to one model or add a mapping layer.

ContraBonListTable puts data-testid on the outer wrapper div, not on the <table>; automation that measures the table (min-width/overflow) will read the wrapper. Consider a separate testid for the table element.

Blanket unit validation lives in blanket_po_service.create_blanket via uom_rules_service.convert_with_trail — good, and the 400 message names the SKU and the offending unit. Call-off equally enforces contract unit. No changes needed.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 blanket unit tests; approval-rules endpoint returns 200 but with a schema the UI cannot render)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 6 targeted fixes verified; 1 unrelated HIGH bug found in Aturan Persetujuan

seed_data_creation: Created via API: blanket contracts KSC/PO-00018, KSC/PO-00019 (product BTK-MEGA-001, supplier Palembang Silk House, notes TEST_ITER272). Created via UI: purchase order KSC/PO-00020 (NTT Weaving Co, Gudang Jakarta Utara, 25 yard BTK-MEGA-001, Grade A, Rp 3.388.275). Mutated: PO KSC/PO-00015 stage 'celup' -> in_progress.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is a STATIC build; do not edit FE code. Nav facts learned this session: PO hub = nav-group-toggle-pembelian -> nav-purchase-orders, hub tabs are hub-tab-purchasing / hub-tab-po-board / hub-tab-blanket-po (NOT blanket-pos) / hub-tab-makloon-orders. Kontrabon = nav-accounts-payable -> hub-tab-contra-bons. Interco transfers = nav-group-toggle-gudang -> nav-wms-operations -> hub-tab-interco-transfers (NOT a top-level nav). Blanket create button = blanket-create-button. PO create: create-po-button -> mode-finished-goods -> supplier-master-select / warehouse-select / item-product-select / item-qty-input / item-price-input / item-expected-grade-select -> add-item-button -> submit-po-button. Avoid supplier sup_grp_ksc_kanda (group entity: blanket POST returns 409 and PO submit button is disabled by design). Blanket POST body uses items[].contract_qty/contract_price/unit and the response returns 'contract_items' (not 'items'). pytest must be run with `-n 0` (pytest.ini forces xdist loadscope, which breaks class-shared state). Login response key is 'token'. Many screens use div-grid pseudo tables (petty cash, PR list, RFQ, supplier master, price approvals) — a <table> based audit finds nothing there; those need a grid-specific harness (see /app/tests/audit.js).
rca_of_the_issue: FIX-1..FIX-6 root causes were correctly addressed: PO number column widened to 115px + whitespace-nowrap on number and status pills (measured getClientRects().length == 1 for all rows/badges), ContraBonsView now uses a conditional single-column grid and the cb-detail-empty placeholder is gone (count 0), InterCompanyTransfers item tables are table-layout:fixed with explicit 170px/220px columns and 6px/8px padding (identical x offsets 1153/1323 across all 4 cards), Blanket unit is a KNSelect fed by the UOM catalog and the backend rejects out-of-catalog units in both create_blanket and prepare_call_off, PoBoardView renders po-board-open-{id} buttons wired to onOpenDocument (verified navigation + focusDoc opens KSC/PO-00015 detail), and PoStageModal saves via PATCH /purchase-orders/{id}/stage (200) with the chip recolouring to amber. The one new defect (Aturan Persetujuan) predates this session and is a data-contract mismatch, not a layout problem.
